name: Ethora MCP Server
description: Create and manage chat apps, rooms and users on the open-source Ethora messaging platform, send and search messages, deploy AI agents with a RAG knowledge base, and generate a website chat widget.

ETHORA_API_URL.description: Ethora API base URL. Defaults to Ethora Cloud (https://api.chat.ethora.com/v1); set it for a self-hosted server.

ETHORA_B2B_TOKEN.description: Optional server-to-server (B2B) token for provisioning automation. Interactive use signs in with the ethora-user-login or ethora-user-register tools instead.
